title: Correct path difference
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly identify the path difference as |PS₁ - PS₂| = 7 m (12 m - 5 m = 7 m from S₂, so difference is |5 m - 7 m| = 2 m).

title: Destructive interference condition
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the condition for destructive interference: path difference = (2n+1)λ/2, where n is an integer.

title: Wave relationship application
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly use the relationship v = fλ to connect wavelength, frequency, and the given speed of sound (340 m/s).

title: Minimum frequency derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must derive and state the final minimum frequency as 85 Hz, obtained by setting n=0 in f = (2n+1)v/(2Δl).

title: Integer n interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The response must recognize that n=0 gives the smallest positive frequency satisfying the destructive interference condition.

title: Sign error in path difference
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the path difference is incorrectly calculated (e.g., using 5 m + 7 m = 12 m instead of |5 m - 7 m| = 2 m).

title: Constructive interference misuse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the condition for constructive interference (path difference = nλ) is mistakenly used instead of the condition for destructive interference.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The response demonstrates unit analysis, ensuring final frequency is in Hz (s⁻¹) and consistent with v (m/s) and Δl (m).
